name: Whelk [bulot]
definition: Sea snail of the whelk family (Buccinum and relatives) sold for eating, whole in the shell or as meat.
notes: Sofrimar cooked whole whelk and whelk meat frozen; Fukuyama white and red whelk; bulot named on snail page

name: Periwinkle [winkle]
definition: Small sea snail Littorina littorea and relatives sold for eating, whole in the shell or as meat.
notes: Frozen cooked flower periwinkle snails (Mua Lobster); Happy Elephant periwinkle in sauces; species not stated

name: Mud snail
definition: Small mud or field snail (Bullacta and freshwater relatives) sold plain for eating, whole or as meat.
notes: JEOLLANAM-DO frozen cooked mud snail meat 200 g; species not stated, Bullacta unconfirmed

name: Apple snail
definition: Large freshwater snail of Pila or Pomacea sold for eating, whole or as meat.
notes: Dragonfly steamed apple snail frozen 350 g; genus Pila or Pomacea not stated on page

name: Top shell (top snail)
definition: Sea snail of the top-shell or turban-shell families sold for eating, whole or as meat.
notes: Top snail cooked in coconut juice, frozen; dried sliced top shell also sold as sea conch; family not stated

name: Land snail [escargot]
definition: Land snail of Helix, Cornu or Achatina sold for eating, live, plain cooked or brined; snails in garlic butter are prepared.
notes: Canned Helix pomatia Burgundy snails (Sabarot; Bourgogne Escargots, salted broth); no live-snail seller found

name: Clam
definition: Hard- or soft-shell clam (Meretrix, Ruditapes, Mercenaria and relatives) sold for eating, live, chilled or frozen.
notes: Frozen pre-cooked Meretrix clams, whole or half shell, 1 kg; species not given beyond genus

name: Razor clam
definition: Long-shelled razor clam (Ensis, Solen, Sinonovacula) sold for eating.
notes: Wild Razorshell Clams, frozen cooked in own juice, Galicia; species not stated; Weee also lists razor clam in sauce

name: Cockle
definition: Cockle (Cerastoderma and relatives) sold for eating, in the shell or as meat.
notes: Cooked shelled cockle meat 200 g frozen, Denmark; Dorset Shellfish cockles 1 kg sold in shells

name: Capelin roe [masago]
definition: Roe of the capelin Mallotus villosus, very small eggs sold plain or seasoned.
notes: Oceankist Masago Seasoned Capelin Roe, frozen; page names capelin, gives no Latin name

name: Herring roe [kazunoko]
definition: Roe of herring sold separately from the fish, as whole skeins or flakes, salted or seasoned.
notes: Hokkaido Kazunoko 500 g and Hokkaido Yamato Herring Roe Flakes; salted or seasoned status not stated

name: Pollock roe [tarako; myeongran]
definition: Roe of Alaska pollock Gadus chalcogrammus, sold as salted or seasoned whole sacs.
notes: Deokhwa seasoned pollock roe, salted with pepper-paste marinade; whole sac versus tube not stated; Kanefuku mentaiko

name: Cod roe
definition: Roe of cod Gadus morhua and relatives sold whole, fresh, salted or smoked.
notes: Hot Smoked Icelandic Cod Roe, pair of vacuum-packed roes, frozen; ready to eat once defrosted

name: Kaluga caviar
definition: Roe of the kaluga sturgeon Huso dauricus, sold as grain caviar.
notes: OLMA Kaluga Royal Caviar, large pearls, sourced from sturgeon farms; page gives no Latin name

name: Amur sturgeon caviar
definition: Roe of the Amur sturgeon Acipenser schrenckii, sold as grain caviar.
notes: Browne Trading Imperial Schrenckii Amur caviar, pure Acipenser schrenckii, China; OLMA Imperial Amur is a hybrid, not this

name: White sturgeon caviar
definition: Roe of the white sturgeon Acipenser transmontanus, sold as grain caviar.
notes: Tsar Nicoulai white sturgeon (Acipenser transmontanus) caviar, Wilton CA; OLMA lists White Sturgeon Caviar

name: Sterlet caviar
definition: Roe of the sterlet Acipenser ruthenus, sold as small-grain caviar.
notes: OLMA Sterlet Caviar, Acipenser ruthenus, farmed, small pearls, malossol

name: Hackleback caviar
definition: Roe of the shovelnose sturgeon Scaphirhynchus platorynchus, sold as grain caviar.
notes: OLMA Hackleback Caviar from wild American sturgeon of Missouri and Mississippi rivers; Latin name not given

name: Paddlefish caviar
definition: Roe of the American paddlefish Polyodon spathula, sold as grain caviar.
notes: Wild paddlefish (Polyodon spathula) caviar from Tennessee; Caviar Co page calls it roe, not caviar

name: Bowfin roe [choupique]
definition: Roe of the bowfin Amia calva, sold as black small-grain roe and often labelled caviar.
notes: OLMA Bowfin Caviar, Amia calva, brownish to black, also named Choupique; page says not sturgeon

name: Grey mullet roe
definition: Roe of grey mullet (Mugil) sold whole, fresh or salted, pressed and dried.
notes: Bottarga, cured thin-lipped grey mullet roe, vacuum-packed, sold frozen or chilled; cure is the form sold

name: Dried abalone
definition: Abalone dried whole for rehydrating and cooking, sold by count per catty.
notes: Dried abalone sold by head count and weight (Dalian, South African); On Kee 3-4 pcs per half catty

name: Fish maw
definition: Dried swim bladder of croaker, sturgeon or other fish, sold for rehydrating and cooking.
notes: Fudonghai dried fish bladder, croaker maw, sturgeon maw and codfish maw listed; many listings state no species

name: Dried shark fin
definition: Shark fin dried for rehydrating and cooking; protected-species status goes to the C17 ledger.
notes: Listing "dried shark fin 50 g"; no species or CITES status shown; other shark-fin items are soups

name: Dried bonito [katsuobushi]
definition: Skipjack tuna boiled, smoked and dried hard, sold as whole blocks or shaved flakes.
notes: Katsuobushi sold as whole blocks (honkarebushi) and shaved flakes; Kaneso, Marutomo, Kyuemon flakes

name: Cured salmon [gravlax]
definition: Salmon cured in salt and sugar, often with dill, not smoked, sold chilled and sliced.
notes: Sliced Salmon Beetroot Gravadlax: salt, sugar, dill, beetroot cure, not smoked; sold frozen, not chilled

name: Smoked haddock
definition: Haddock cold- or hot-smoked, sold as fillets or whole split fish.
notes: Wild Grimsby smoked haddock fillet steaks; Arbroath smokies are hot-smoked whole haddock; both sold frozen

name: Smoked sprats [Sprotten]
definition: Sprats Sprattus sprattus smoked whole and sold chilled; tinned smoked sprats are J2.4 (P3).
notes: Deutsche See Sprotten 130 g in smoked fish category; chilled status not stated on page

name: Tinned anchovies [anchoas]
definition: Salt-cured anchovy fillets or whole anchovies packed in oil or salt in a sealed tin or jar.
notes: AllTinned anchovy page: 665 tins; fillets in olive or sunflower oil, or in salt (Pujado Solano, Delfino Battista)

name: Marinated anchovies [boquerones]
definition: Raw anchovy fillets marinated in vinegar, oil and garlic, sold chilled in a tray or jar.
notes: Boquerones marinated anchovy fillets: vinegar-marinated, 75 g tray in sunflower oil, sold frozen; AllTinned lists marinated white anchovy tins

name: Tinned mackerel
definition: Mackerel fillets or pieces packed in a sealed tin or jar.
notes: AllTinned mackerel page: 826 tins in oil, tomato, mustard sauces (Ramirez, Saupiquet, Jose Gourmet)

name: Tinned herring
definition: Herring fillets or pieces packed in a sealed tin, smoked or not; jarred marinated herring is J2.4.04.
notes: AllTinned herring page: 224 tins, smoked in oil, in tomato or mustard sauce (Appel, Stella Maris, Banga)

name: Tinned sprats
definition: Sprats or brisling (Sprattus) packed in a sealed tin, often smoked.
notes: AllTinned sprat page: 201 tins; brisling in oil, water, tomato, and smoked (Riga Gold, John West, Kaviari)

name: Tinned salmon
definition: Salmon packed in a sealed tin or jar.
notes: AllTinned salmon page: 326 tins, pink and red salmon in water, oil, smoked (John West, Sealord, Ramirez)

name: Tinned mussels
definition: Cooked mussels packed in a sealed tin or jar, in brine, oil or sauce.
notes: AllTinned mussel page: 550 tins, mostly mejillones en escabeche or sauces (Albo, Daporta, Calvo)

name: Tinned octopus
definition: Cooked octopus packed in a sealed tin or jar.
notes: AllTinned octopus page: 205 tins, mostly in olive oil, some smoked or in marinera sauce (Albo, Jose Gourmet)

name: Tinned squid
definition: Squid packed in a sealed tin or jar, often in its ink.
notes: AllTinned squid page: 260 tins; baby squid in ink, tomato sauce, oil (Albo, Cabo de Penas)
